comparison: Perfect agreement on PVH microglial morphological changes (C35-C41, C5-C6, C65-C66, C73-C74, C78-C79). Both evaluations find the evidence SUPPORTED with high-quality imaging and quantitative data showing transient increases at P16 that resolve by P30.

Strong disagreement on PLX5622 microglial depletion experiments (C8, C53-C54, C80-C81). OpenEval finds evidence SUPPORTED for rescue of AgRP fiber density, while peer reviewers rate UNCERTAIN due to lack of microglial assessment during the critical P16 window (only assessed at P55).

Disagreement on body weight rescue findings (C9, C55-C56, C64, C71). OpenEval finds SUPPORTED with appropriate statistics, but peer reviewers rate UNCERTAIN, questioning causality and noting manipulations were not PVH-specific, plus incomplete metabolic analysis.

Perfect agreement on BST regional specificity (C49-C51, C77, C82). Both evaluations find SUPPORTED that MHFD-L produces no effects in BST, strengthening the conclusion of PVH-specific microglial changes.

Agreement on concerns about microglial depletion timing (C52). OpenEval notes SUPPORTED but acknowledges missing data on depletion extent and timing. Peer reviewers rate UNCERTAIN, emphasizing the critical gap of no assessment at P16 when effects are hypothesized to occur.

Strong agreement on ARH regional specificity (C43-C47, C75-C76). Both evaluations find SUPPORTED that microglia and AgRP neurons show no MHFD-L effects in ARH, demonstrating PVH-specific changes. OpenEval includes C48 (AgRP neuron numbers) not explicitly mentioned in peer review.

Strong agreement on microglial engulfment of AgRP terminals (C7, C57, C62, C67, C93-C94). Both evaluations find SUPPORTED as a novel demonstration using genetic labeling and 3D reconstruction. OpenEval includes C102 not in peer review.

Strong agreement on negative engulfment findings (C58-C59, C63, C68, C95-C96, C103). Both evaluations find SUPPORTED that no differences in engulfment were observed between MHFD-L and NCD groups, ruling out enhanced pruning as the mechanism. OpenEval and peer reviewers both note this points to alternative mechanisms.

Agreement on reduced AgRP terminal density (C4, C42). Both evaluations find SUPPORTED with quantitative data from Figure 1K. OpenEval additionally addresses C21 and C23 (no AgRP neuron loss), with C23 partially covered in peer R5.

Partial overlap on regional/subdomain specificity and mechanistic interpretation (C83, C90, C101). OpenEval finds SUPPORTED for the observed heterogeneity while noting mechanisms are unclear. Peer reviewers rate UNCERTAIN, emphasizing that morphology alone is insufficient and proposed mechanisms (C97, C100, C104) are speculative.

Agreement on developmental CD68 increases (C60-C61). Both evaluations find SUPPORTED. OpenEval treats this as contextual data from prior literature, while peer reviewers incorporate it into their assessment of the engulfment findings.

Partial disagreement on microglial activation interpretation (C10-C11, C66). OpenEval finds SUPPORTED but notes activation is inferred from morphology without direct markers. Peer reviewers rate related mechanistic claims UNCERTAIN, stating morphology alone doesn't reflect functional signaling alterations.

Agreement on speculative mechanisms (C89, C97, C104). OpenEval rates UNCERTAIN, explicitly noting these are untested hypotheses appropriately qualified as speculation. Peer reviewers similarly rate UNCERTAIN, emphasizing alternative mechanisms like secreted factors remain speculative.

Partial overlap on AgRP neuron numbers (C23). OpenEval finds SUPPORTED that no cell loss occurred. Peer reviewers express UNCERTAINTY about measurement clarity, questioning whether AgRP neurons, terminals, or both were quantified in Figure 2.

Minimal overlap on broad synthesis (C100). OpenEval finds SUPPORTED as a cautious general conclusion. Peer reviewers incorporate this into their UNCERTAIN rating of mechanistic claims, noting the demonstrated microglial role but questioning the proposed mechanisms.
OpenEval finds contextual claims from prior research (C2-C3, C17-C19) SUPPORTED with appropriate citations. No corresponding peer review evaluation found for these background claims.
OpenEval finds maternal programming context claims (C12-C16, C20-C22, C69-C70, C98-C99) SUPPORTED as prior knowledge establishing study rationale. No corresponding peer review evaluation found.
OpenEval finds microglial biology context claims (C25-C34) SUPPORTED with appropriate citations as conceptual framework. No corresponding peer review evaluation found for these background claims.

OpenEval finds microglial developmental function context claims (C84-C88, C91-C92) SUPPORTED as prior knowledge. Peer R5 mentions C85 regarding AgRP measurement clarity but doesn't evaluate the contextual claim itself.

OpenEval finds methodological claims (C105-C120) SUPPORTED, noting appropriate genetic models, treatment protocols, imaging approaches, and statistical methods. No corresponding peer review evaluation found for methods claims.
